profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer, Priceless Platform at Mastercard
profile.summary: Software Engineer with 10+ years in full-stack LAMP system development, and 8+ years in online performance marketing focused in email channel.  Co-founded two marketing companies; product managed and implemented all engineering projects.  Worked in small teams of just founding partners and grew to manage operations of over 20 employees.  Looking to further advance in a technical role.

positions.title: Co-Founder/ Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Architected and managed RDBMS in MySQL for transactional and analytical data for email users, and IP/offer performance. 
•	Created data management API to handle daily batch FTP feed and real-time HTTP feed.
•	Configured and managed AWS services.
•	Built full-stack LAMP systems for the entire operation and performance tracking database; running Zend as the PHP framework, and jQuery for JavaScript.
•	Implemented automation of daily operational tasks.
•	Developed performance driven data segmentation scripts and ad-hoc reports that guided the R&D direction.

positions.title: Co-Founder/ Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Developed full-stack LAMP system in an agile environment for internal e-mail deployment platform and campaign management platform; using Zend as the PHP framework, and ExtJS as the JavaScript framework.
•	Designed and maintained RDBMS in MySQL. 
•	Built automated system status verification and backend performance analysis/reporting in Perl.
•	Integrated 3rd party real-time email targeting API with internal auto-responder system.
•	Integrated external email marketing solution platform with internal mailing process. 
•	Led engineering and R&D team for project planning and releasing. 
•	Managed operation team of over 20 employees.

positions.title: Lead Engineer
positions.description:
•	Managed a team of 3 engineers.
•	Worked closely with PM to define the project specifications, draft initial logic and architect DB design.
•	Developed and supported internal e-mail campaign management/reporting platform in LAMP environment.
•	Developed campaign deployment system in Java with Perl as backend.
•	Managed large scale of user data in a relational DB via MySQL for daily mailing and analysis.
•	Generated custom analysis reports and user segmentations in Perl.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Implemented web-based tools for fulfillment users in LAMP environment and Javascript.
•	Created crawler in Perl to automate the fulfillment process.
•	Researched and consolidated PHP and MySQL code for performance enhancement.
•	Developed and debugged XML/SOAP interactions with major partners to complete order fulfillment.
•	Provided full support for our fulfillment center users.
